title: To Funk or Not To Funk
description: To Funk or Not To Funk — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sam 'Dog Walker'

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Take the Funk away from Tofunk the new DJ in the Fridged Bean.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sam 'Dog Walker'

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Semi-Precious Metal

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Take the Funk away from Tofunk the new DJ in the Fridged Bean.

Offer:

This Dancing that has been going on inside is not just the fault of the dancers, the blame is also upon the ones making the music. These monsters making the music to dance the unholy dances must be stopped less they continue to make music that is then considered unholy. I will report to the King's Bishop's Knight's Stable Boy of what we are hearing here, and you go in there and make the music that is coming from the Friged Bean stop.

I will no doubt be back before you. So when you have stopped the playing of the funky music come back to me, the King's Bishop's Knight's Stable Boy's Dog Walker here at Balzack's Base Camp.

Turn-in:

Even though you have been able to stop one of the unholy sounds of one of the monster musicians, the problem persists. Take this small token of my thanks.

Objectives:

  • Tofunk the Funky DJ

Level range: 55–100
